clause: DESIGN R3.3 §9.4 Region geometry, including Process IO
witness: an anchor left of the content box clamps to contentLeft
derivation: In_A anchored on a node centred at x 20000: desired left 2000 < contentLeft 40000, so left 40000; In_B anchored at centre 350000: left 332000. Row rule (spec §4.3): items in §7.2 placement order; footprint max(object, label) width; left = anchor centre - footprint/2 when the anchor is shown, else contentLeft or previous right + gap; clamp to contentLeft; collision shifts right; one row at the top of the support body [Ly, Ly+RH], RH = max(minHeight, max(object+label) + 2 padding) (harmonization K2); every object centre lies on one line cy = Ly + max(A, (RH + A - B)/2), A = max h/2, B = max(h/2 + label height), so the union of the stacks is centred in the row (DESIGN §9.4 'align centers on one IO row'); exact rationals, one roundEven per output coordinate.
author: spec-seal
